positions.title: Associate Marketing Manager
positions.description:
• Drive marketing campaigns including creative direction, production, asset management, and quality assessment.
• Partnered with cross functional departments to create and oversee organic marketing strategies to drive acquisition and member retention ​for multiple name brand retail clothing companies.
• Analyze campaign performance weekly, monthly, and quarterly and develop reports to recommend strategic and tactical testing opportunities in marketing, content, and merchandising campaigns.
• Lead ad-hoc team projects and oversee projects from development to execution.

positions.title: Associate Marketing Manager
positions.description:
• Work cross-functionally with various departments to enable the sales team to meet commercial objectives by providing them appropriate tools, materials, and presentations.
• Developed and executed cross-channel marketing strategy for new and existing products
• Managed operations of marketing automation systems (HubSpot, SalesForce.com) and website (WordPress)
• Partner with the product development and product management teams on new product launches.
• Develop and deliver marketing and communications strategies for the organization.
• Manage marketing spend and budgeting
• Oversaw Trade Show management from event coordination to developing and executing all marketing materials

positions.title: Marketing Operations Manager
positions.description:
• Work cross-functionally with various departments to enable the sales team to meet commercial objectives by providing them appropriate tools, materials, and presentations.
• Analyzed marketing and sales data to develop KPIs and make recommendations to optimize marketing strategy and increase web traffic
• Managed the development and operations of marketing automation systems (HubSpot, SalesForce.com) and website (WordPress)
• Partner with the product development and product management teams on new product launches.
• Develop and deliver marketing and communications strategies for the organization.
• Manage marketing spend and budgeting
• Oversaw Trade Show management from event coordination to developing and executing all marketing materials
• Lead on implementation of marketing automation platform (Pardot to HubSpot)

positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
• Partnered with the Director of Marketing to drive the development and implementation of all product marketing activities
• Work cross functionally with various departments to coordinate the development and production of technical literature to support sales team through customer visits.

• Managed marketing CRMs (Pardot & SalesForce) and website CMS (Wordpress)
• Reviewed and implemented changes to optimize SEO presence monthly
